column1: # TiDB parser corpus from Bytebase's own TiDB test files: §3.4 sample 3 of the
# drop-pingcap design. These are the SQL statements Bytebase already promises to
# handle -- the inputs its TiDB parser, advisor and schema code are tested on --
# with the verdict omni/tidb/parser and TiDB v8.5.5 each give each one.
# Where the pingcap corpora are pingcap's own grammar cases, these are the forms
# Bytebase's users and tests actually drive through the TiDB path: column rules,
# naming checks, DML dry-runs, schema syncs and walk-throughs.
#   omni    accept | reject -- what tidb/parser.Parse does with the statement
#   engine  accept | reject -- whether TiDB v8.5.5 accepts the syntax, via the
#           same PREPARE harness the other TiDB corpora use
#   sql     the statement, verbatim, one line
# A gap is a row with omni reject and engine accept; an over-acceptance is the
# reverse and is a bug -- and these forms are ones Bytebase ships against.
# Column 2 is measured, never hand-edited: see README.md.
# Provenance: extracted from github.com/bytebase/bytebase at commit
# 5a6096dfd5cdf32ae1b13493065af89bd2ea1e07, from the 64 TiDB test files under
# A throwaway Go extractor read the input-side SQL -- the values at the
# top-level case keys statement, input, oldSchema, newSchema and schema -- split
# each script with tidb/parser.Split, trimmed, and kept the non-empty segments.
# Top-level keys only, so a query-span source column's nested `schema` and a
# backup case's generated `result` statements are not picked up. Generated-output
# get_database_definition) is Bytebase-synthesized, not promised input, and is
# excluded. From 600 scripts / 945 split segments: 527 rows kept, after dropping
# 194 multi-line statements (embedded newline/tab -- this format is one
# statement per line, as the pingcap corpora are), 209 internal duplicates, and
# Bytebase is distributed under a source-available license (github.com/bytebase/
# bytebase); these rows are omni's own project's test fixtures, read at test time
# and not compiled into omni, and add no module dependency. See README.md.
